design_principles.1: Glanceable, operational dashboard: clear North Star metric with progressive disclosure for deep drill-downs.
design_principles.2: Function over decoration. Monochrome base with pure, functional colors strictly reserved for interaction and status.
design_principles.3: Control Room Grid: High data density, cardless or sharp minimal borders, optimal for fast scanning.
design_principles.4: Every interactive element must support high-velocity sales actions (one-click WhatsApp/LinkedIn).

typography.strategy: Swiss brutalist clarity for headers, engineered legibility for dense tables.

layout.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12 (Generous padding on forms, tight padding on tables)
layout.alignment: Left-align all text and tabular data. Center-align empty states only.
layout.borders_and_radius: Sharp edges. Use `rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm` for an engineered, precise SaaS look.

tables.style: Cardless, full-width. border-b for rows, no vertical borders. hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors.
tables.implementation: Shadcn UI Table, customized with dense padding (py-2 instead of py-4) and tabular-nums.

drawers.style: Right-side slide-out (Sheet). Backdrop blur bg-black/20. Sharp corners.
drawers.implementation: Shadcn UI Sheet. Used for deep-dives into prospect site audit (/100) and AI messages.

buttons.style: Minimal padding, sharp corners (rounded-sm). Always show distinct hover states. Use icons for WhatsApp/LinkedIn actions.
buttons.implementation: Shadcn UI Button. Variants: default (Brand Blue), outline (Action/Secondary), ghost (Table rows).

cards.style: Flat surface. 1px solid border-slate-200. No shadows. Internal padding p-6.
cards.implementation: Raw HTML/Tailwind divs with border, bg-white.

inputs.style: Square inputs, sharp borders. focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-950.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. transition-colors duration-150 ease-out.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use indeterminate horizontal progress bars at the top of cards, or minimal spinner.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: Accessibility first: 2px offset ring, using brand primary color or pure black.
interactions_and_motion.progress_bar: For the Scraper page, use a smooth transforming width transition with a monospace percentage counter.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format reflecting their role.

media.icons_library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for precise, geometric dashboard icons.

mock_artisan_1.description: Middle-aged artisan in workshop. Use for mock prospect profile pictures.

mock_artisan_2.description: Artisan working. Use for mock prospect profile pictures.

mock_user_avatar.description: Professional avatar. Use for the logged-in sales rep profile in the top-right or sidebar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all components, NOT TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Set up standard React + Tailwind CSS with Shadcn primitives.
Implement a persistent left sidebar layout for main navigation (File du jour, Prospects, Scraper, Import, Templates, Settings).
Build the 'File du jour' as an ultra-dense, actionable list. The WhatsApp button must be prominently green (#25D366) and the LinkedIn button blue (#0A66C2).
Use Shadcn Sheet for the Prospect Detail view to prevent navigating away from the 'File du jour' table, ensuring maximum speed.
Ensure the Scraper page has a mock live progress bar (0-100%) and a status log console area.
Do not use generic gray text for headings; force `#111111` for high-contrast clarity.
Enforce `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms as specified in the testing rules.
